definition: A statement reporting this document paid to shareholders by corporations, mutual funds, regulated investment companies, and real estate investment trusts, including ordinary dividends, capital gain distributions, and various categories of investment income.

includes.text: Reports multiple categories of dividend and distribution income including ordinary dividends, qualified dividends, and capital gain distributions
Distinguishes qualified dividends eligible for preferential tax rates
Reports capital gain distributions from investment companies
Includes federal income tax withheld on distributions

excludes.text: Does not report miscellaneous income such as substitute dividend payments, broker fees, or other non-dividend payments
excludes.quote: Substitute payments in lieu of dividends

excludes.text: Does not report mortgage interest paid by borrowers
Does not report simple interest income from savings accounts or bonds

discriminators.text: Reports dividend and distribution income with multiple tax-rate categories; the sibling reports miscellaneous income from various non-dividend sources including rents, royalties, and other payments
Reports investment distributions and capital gains; the sibling reports only mortgage interest paid by individual borrowers
Reports dividends and capital gain distributions from corporations and investment companies; the sibling reports only interest income from savings and debt instruments
